items.title: Does Room Expansion Change The Bull Case For Hilton Stock?
items.summary: Hilton Worldwide Holdings is operating a 1.41 million room system across 28 brands, with net unit growth of 6.0% as of September 30, 2026. The fastest expansion is coming from luxury and lifestyle hotels, supported by a record pipeline of rooms in development.
